method_notes: These are real browser captures, parsed offline after the fixes; observation.observed_at remains 0 to avoid presenting saved HTML as a fresh poll.
The reviewed page state is a human classification; runtime availability remains unknown except for explicit interpreted resale listings.
Navigation followed verified artist links in ordinary graphical Chromium; it differs from the background worker direct-event path.
Informational display controls and optional-cookie rejection only; no login, presale code, ticket selection, reservation or purchase.
HTML remains private. Public report contains event facts and normalized observations.
A single sample per event does not establish sustainable access, detection latency, worldwide support, total stock, or guaranteed fulfillment.
